title: Independent Contractor Agreement

issues.quote: Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to complete the Services by April 30, 2027.
issues.why: "commercially reasonable efforts" instead of the single MSCD standard (MSCD ch. 8).
issues.fix: Contractor shall use reasonable efforts to complete the Services ...

issues.quote: Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to complete the Services by April 30, 2027.
issues.why: "by" leaves unclear whether April 30 is included.

issues.quote: Studio may assign personnel to coordinate with Contractor on the Services.
issues.why: "assign" is a term of art for transferring rights; here it means designate.
issues.fix: Studio may designate personnel to coordinate with Contractor ...

issues.quote: Contractor will be paid $95 per hour for the Services, up to a maximum of $28,500.
issues.fix: Studio shall pay Contractor $95 per hour for the Services, up to a maximum of $28,500.

issues.quote: Contractor shall invoice Studio monthly, and Studio shall pay each invoice submitted by Contractor no later than 15 days after receiving it.
Studio must reimburse Contractor for travel expenses that Studio approves in advance.
issues.why: "must" for a duty on the subject, a party.

issues.quote: Contractor shall deliver all Deliverables to Studio no later than 5 days after Studio requests them.
issues.why: "Deliverables" is used but never defined; the defined term is "Work Product".
issues.fix: Contractor shall deliver all Work Product to Studio ...

issues.quote: Studio may terminate this agreement by notice to Contractor if Contractor fails to make substantial progress on the Services.
issues.why: Undefined "substantial" where a measure was possible (it controls a termination right).
issues.fix: State a measure: for example, fails to deliver the page designs in Schedule A no later than March 15, 2027.

issues.quote: If Studio terminates this agreement under Section D.2, Studio shall pay Contractor for all hours that Contractor worked before termination.
issues.fix: If Studio terminates this agreement for lack of progress, ...

issues.quote: Contractor represents and warrants that Contractor has the skills and licenses necessary to perform the Services.
issues.why: Blake's own draft: statements of fact use "states" (house rule 10), as E.2 does.
issues.fix: Contractor states that Contractor has the skills and licenses necessary to perform the Services.

issues.quote: Studio shall be entitled to recover its attorneys' fees if Studio prevails in any action to enforce this agreement.
issues.why: "shall be entitled to": no duty imposed.
issues.fix: Studio is entitled to recover its attorneys' fees if Studio prevails ...

traps.anchor: No one other than Contractor may
traps.quote: No one other than Contractor may perform the Services without Studio's prior written consent.
traps.why_correct: "no one" keeps its word, and a negative subject with "may" is the correct prohibition (house rule 8).

traps.anchor: Section 1401 of the Internal Revenue Code
traps.quote: Contractor is responsible for all taxes on payments under this agreement, including self-employment tax under Section 1401 of the Internal Revenue Code.

traps.anchor: are work made for hire under
traps.quote: All designs, code, text, and other materials that Contractor creates in performing the Services (the "Work Product") are work made for hire under the Copyright Act, and Studio owns the Work Product.
Studio is not required to provide Contractor with equipment, training, or benefits.
Contractor is liable for any damage that Contractor's equipment causes to Studio's property.

notes: Blake's draft. Party names correctly have no article; enumeration, spacing, and attachments (Schedule A) are correct. "Contractor assigns to Studio all copyright" uses "assign" in its legal sense and is correct; only "assign personnel" is the term-of-art issue.
